value.rationale: This is a complete calculation of a standard structural/knot-theoretic polynomial invariant for every member of the new universal quandle family, not a small example or arbitrary parameter slice. It converts pointwise fixing interactions into a natural centralizer-orbit formula, yields an exact fixed-pair count equal to a cumulative partition sum, its sharp asymptotic, and a distinguished minimal monomial. The combination supplies quantitative information not recorded by universality or component labels alone.
